items.title: Lumbini Lions seal playoff spot as Karnali Yaks suffer fourth straight defeat
items.desc: The defending champions climbed to the top of the Nepal Premier League standings with a six-wicket win, while Karnali’s hopes of reaching the playoffs suffered another setback.

items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns in big blow to AI boom
items.desc: Huang, who co-founded Nvidia and is its fourth-largest investor ‌with a stake of about 3.61 percent, will exit the board as well.

items.title: RSP delegation to visit China at Communist Party’s invitation
items.desc: The 20-member team, led by General Secretary Bipin Kumar Acharya, will hold discussions on governance, economic development and political cooperation during its visit from November 15.

items.title: Captain change fails to revive Karnali Yaks
items.desc: David Miller took over from Sompal Kami, but Karnali were bowled out for 105 against Lumbini Lions, leaving their playoff hopes hanging by a thread.

items.title: Madhesh chief minister to seek confidence vote on November 14
items.desc: Chief Minister Krishna Prasad Yadav is seeking a vote of confidence after the CPN-UML and Nepali Communist Party, both members of his coalition government, withdrew their support.

items.title: Congo Ebola outbreak still out of control after six months, MSF says
items.desc: With the number of confirmed cases now surpassing 11,000, the outbreak is the second-worst on record.

items.title: Lamichhane’s record six-wicket haul keeps Biratnagar’s playoff hopes alive
items.desc: The Biratnagar Kings captain took the first hat-trick of NPL Season 3 to bowl out Pokhara Avengers for 132 before his side chased down the target with four wickets to spare.

items.title: 11 of 13 killed in Makawanpur microbus crash identified
items.desc: The electric minibus was travelling from Kathmandu to Sarlahi when it plunged off the road at Chisapanigadhi along the Bhimphedi-Kulekhani-Kathmandu road section at around 5:45 am on Thursday.

items.title: Lamichhane takes NPL’s first hat-trick and six-wicket haul as Pokhara set 133-run target
items.desc: The leg-spinner dismisses five batters in a decisive spell, including Yuvraj Samra, who had struck 84 off 47 balls, to leave Biratnagar Kings chasing 133 against Pokhara Avengers.

items.title: Why Chhath is more than a day on Nepal’s calendar
items.desc: Nepal’s treatment of the five-day festival exposes deeper failures in recognising Madheshi heritage, addressing gender inequality, ensuring caste inclusion and protecting the environment.

items.title: A journey home for Chhath turns deadly
items.desc: Sanjay Yadav recounts how he was thrown from a microbus that plunged 700 metres down a slope in Makawanpur, killing 10 passengers.

items.title: A 15-year-old builds her village a bridge after her appeal goes unanswered
items.desc: Sadiksha Oli used Rs60,000 from her Facebook earnings to build a wooden crossing after her appeal to former prime minister Pushpa Kamal Dahal went unanswered.

items.title: Crossing the border for a better education
items.desc: From village schools in Jhapa and Bardiya to CBSE institutions in Birgunj, children from neighbouring Indian communities are crossing into Nepal daily in search of better schooling.

items.title: Nepal seeks mountain-specific early warning systems after devastating flood
items.desc: Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal calls for better cross-border data sharing, improved high-altitude monitoring and predictable climate finance to protect vulnerable communities.

items.title: 10 killed, five injured as electric microbus plunges off road in Makawanpur
items.desc: The vehicle was carrying passengers from Sarlahi returning home for Chhath. The driver and one passenger have been identified, while a three-year-old boy was rescued alive.

items.title: Former deputy prime minister Top Bahadur Rayamajhi released after sentence cut
items.desc: His four-year prison term in the fake Bhutanese refugee scam was reduced to three years under provisions for senior citizens.

items.title: UN chief urges climate justice and greater support for vulnerable countries
items.desc: Guterres warns climate action is falling behind as Nepal presses for greater recognition of Himalayan vulnerabilities.

items.title: Nvidia board meets to decide CEO Huang’s future, source says
items.desc: The reported move comes amid allegations of two extramarital affairs and scrutiny over Huang’s links to a Chinese businesswoman suspected of facilitating restricted chip shipments to China.

items.title: COP31 leaders try out new sales pitch for climate action: do it for the economy
items.desc: Consumer price pressures from fuel to food were a major driver in the US midterm elections ​that handed control of Congress to Democrats, and are an important vulnerability for leaders across Europe, ⁠Asia and elsewhere.

items.title: Russia, Ukraine and US start second day of Abu Dhabi peace talks
items.desc: The new American drive for a deal has galvanized ​European officials into pushing for a place ​at the negotiating table to seek ⁠an end to Europe's deadliest conflict since World War Two.

items.title: Industry Minister Sah visits India for CII Partnership Summit
items.desc: Sah is scheduled to address the Trade Ministers’ Session and hold bilateral meetings to explore opportunities for expanding trade, investment and economic cooperation.

items.title: Nvidia faces deepening scrutiny over China chip ties, CEO affair
items.desc: Allegations linking Huang to a suspected Chinese spy have triggered a board investigation and renewed scrutiny of Nvidia’s chip shipments to China.

items.title: Koshi recognises 13 additional languages for official use
items.desc: The new provision brings the number of languages recognised for government business in the province to 14, including Nepali.

items.title: Palpa’s Dhaka cloth weaves its way from festive gifts to tourist keepsakes
items.desc: Growing demand for Dhaka products as gifts for brothers and relatives during Tihar is helping sustain a traditional craft that embodies Nepal’s cultural identity, even as local production and employment decline.

items.title: Nepal’s push for Himalayan climate agenda falls short at COP31
items.desc: Proposal by Nepal, Bhutan and Kyrgyzstan fails to secure a separate place in formal negotiations; Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal says lack of support from major negotiating blocs remains a hurdle.

items.title: Behind Bangladesh’s garment boom, workers cut food, healthcare as wages fall short
items.desc: Bangladesh’s garment workers say stagnant wages and rising living costs are forcing families to cut back on food, forgo healthcare and pull children out of school, even as the industry drives the country’s export economy.

items.title: Karnali announces trials for 14 sports ahead of National Games
items.desc: Provincial selections will run from November 13 to 20, while athletes in 31 disciplines will undergo closed-camp training ahead of the December 2-13 competition.

items.title: Nepal celebrates Bhai Tika, the final day of Tihar
items.desc: Sisters apply colourful tika to their brothers, praying for their long life, good health and prosperity in a festival rooted in religious belief and family bonds.

items.title: Woman killed in elephant attack in Kanchanpur
items.desc: A herd of elephants entered a settlement inside Shuklaphanta National Park, damaged a house and trampled a 60-year-old woman to death while she was asleep.
